quote: I was supposed to have an appointment today with a gentleman, and I had to cancel because I got called in to work.
stewart_read: This line is the homeowner (mislabeled 'rep') explaining a missed appointment, not a setter running a script — the whole call is an inbound reschedule call, not a standard prospecting call.
alternative_hypothesis: Alternative: this is a genuine setter call where the rep is unusually confused about their own schedule — rejected because the content (apologizing for a no-show, worrying about the 'gentleman' driving out) only fits the homeowner's perspective.
coaching_implication: Flag this call for re-diarization / exclusion from standard setter scoring — it is not comparable to a normal qualifying call.

quote: Is there a better time and day that would work good for you so we can get you
stewart_read: The Ion-side rep attempts to pin a new time but doesn't firmly anchor it with a specific hour or a fairness handshake.
coaching_implication: When rebooking, restate the exact day AND time back to the customer and get an explicit 'does that work' confirmation, not just 'we can try it.'

quote: I'm just gonna shoot for next Tuesday same time?
stewart_read: A day is proposed but the exact clock time is never restated verbally on this call, and the customer's reply is a soft 'We can try it' rather than a firm commitment.
coaching_implication: Should have said 'Tuesday the [date] at 2:30 PM — does that work for you?' to lock a real handshake.

stewart_read: This is a weak, hedged acceptance of the rescheduled slot, not a confident confirmation — no 'is that fair?' handshake follows.
alternative_hypothesis: Could read as genuine uncertainty about work schedule (rep mentioned Friday schedule release) rather than pure disengagement — this is more supported since the speaker explicitly ties it to an employer schedule not yet posted.
coaching_implication: Given the stated schedule uncertainty, the Ion scheduler should have offered a callback window after Friday instead of locking a soft 'next Tuesday' that may not hold.

quote: Awesome. Well, I'll just get you rescheduled for next Tuesday at the same time.
stewart_read: No button-up elements were run: no one-hour block statement, no no-driving/computer instruction, no fairness handshake, no text-follow-up promise.
coaching_implication: Even on a reschedule call, the four button-up elements should be run to protect the rebooked slot from another no-show.
